::: {.resume-header}
# About Me
:::

I'm a Computer Science student at Brigham Young University Idaho, with an expected graduation of December 2027 and an emphasis in Software Engineering and Cyber Security. I'm a C#/.NET developer with hands-on experience across backend APIs (ASP.NET Core), fullstack web development (React/TypeScript), and mobile development (.NET MAUI).

Outside of coursework, I build independent projects focused on API design and authentication — including a full-stack task management app with JWT-secured, user-scoped data, a cross-platform mobile flashcard app, and a desktop password manager with encryption at rest.

My professional background also includes technical support and systems work: I currently support technology infrastructure across a 25-building, 21,000-person campus as a Classroom Technology Technician, resolving an average of 50 tickets per week and performing root-cause analysis to separate software bugs from hardware faults. Previously, as an Assistive Technology Technician, I provided Tier-2 support and translated technical requirements for non-technical users. I've also led teams and coordinated logistics in a full-time capacity, which has strengthened my communication and leadership skills alongside my technical work.
